question: How many artists are in the database?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist

question: How many tracks are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List all media types.
gold: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the longest track's name?
gold: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average track price?
gold: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: Which employees have the title 'Sales Support Agent'? Give first and last names.
gold: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: How many playlists are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: What is the total of all invoice totals?
gold: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Which 5 countries have the most customers?
gold: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, Country LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 customers by total invoice amount? Give their full names.
gold: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total invoice amount per year?
gold: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: Which album has the most tracks?
gold: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employee is the support rep for the most customers? Give their full name.
gold: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which billing country had the highest total invoice amount?
gold: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist generated the most revenue from track sales?
gold: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 genres by revenue?
gold: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most invoice revenue? Give the agent's full name.
gold: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: What percentage of tracks are longer than 5 minutes? Round to one decimal place.
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Milliseconds > 300000) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM Track

question: Which customer spent the most in 2013? Give their full name.
gold: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2013' GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which playlist contains the most tracks?
gold: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who does Steve Johnson report to? Give the manager's full name.
gold: SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE e.FirstName = 'Steve' AND e.LastName = 'Johnson'

question: How many distinct customers bought at least one Jazz track?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: Which month of 2012 had the highest invoice total? Answer with the month number.
gold: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: By what percentage did total invoice revenue grow from 2009 to 2010? Round to one decimal place.
gold: WITH r AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) y, SUM(Total) t FROM Invoice GROUP BY y) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (b.t - a.t) / a.t, 1) FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.y = '2009' AND b.y = '2010'

question: How many employees report to Andrew Adams, directly or indirectly?
gold: WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams') UNION SELECT e.EmployeeId FROM Employee e JOIN sub ON e.ReportsTo = sub.id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub

question: For each year, which billing country had the second-highest invoice total? Give the year and country.
gold: WITH r AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) y, BillingCountry c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC) rk FROM Invoice GROUP BY y, c) SELECT y, c FROM r WHERE rk = 2

question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10)

question: How many artists have tracks in more than one genre?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.ArtistId FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1)

question: Which calendar month had the highest invoice total across the whole history? Answer as YYYY-MM.
gold: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which genre had the second-highest number of tracks sold to customers billed in the USA?
gold: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA' GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Which customers made purchases in every year from 2009 to 2013 and spent more than $45 in total? Give full names.
gold: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate)) = 5 AND SUM(i.Total) > 45

question: What percentage of track-sales revenue came from video tracks (media types containing 'video')? Round to one decimal place.
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mt.Name LIKE '%video%' THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity END) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 1) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId

question: How many customers made no purchases in 2013?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2013')
